topology_reasoning.device_identification: The bitmap shows a compact 1x2 adiabatic splitter / edge-coupled Y-branch style device. A single central left bus taper narrows and terminates before the split, while two initially narrow branch tips begin slightly inboard, widen through the interaction region, then separate through mirrored S-bends into two output guides.
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: The long central taper and two nearby tapered branch tips define an adiabatic power-transfer/splitting region. The branch gap and taper widths set modal overlap and splitting behavior; the following S-bends fan the two arms out to isolated output ports while preserving low-loss curvature.
